title: Prevalence of Anxiety Among Adolescents (Ilala District)
description: A cross-sectional study assessing anxiety levels and associated factors (biological, psychological, social) among 210 adolescents aged 10-15 in Ilala. Utilized GAD-7 and Rosenberg Self-Esteem tools.

title: Postnatal Perception of PPIUCD Use
description: Quantitative study at Mnazi Mmoja Hospital assessing awareness and barriers to Postpartum Intrauterine Contraceptive Devices among 152 postnatal women. Highlighted partner support as a key factor.

title: Midwifery Students' Clinical Transition Experience
description: Qualitative study exploring the challenges undergraduate midwifery students face when transitioning from classroom theory to clinical practice at MUHAS. Identifies key barriers like supervision and resources.

title: Parent-Adolescent SRH Communication (Kinondoni)
description: Descriptive cross-sectional study on the prevalence of communication regarding Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) between parents and adolescents. Analyzed socio-cultural barriers and communication gaps.
